sourceDocuments.title: Corporate Governance Under CAMA 2020
sourceDocuments.text: The Companies and Allied Matters Act 2020 introduces statutory provisions for electronic meetings and electronic share transfers for private limited liability companies.

studentDocument.title: Corporate Rescue Mechanisms in CAMA 2020
studentDocument.text: The Companies and Allied Matters Act 2020 establishes statutory provisions for company voluntary arrangements and administrative receivership to preserve insolvent commercial entities as going concerns.
